name: KMS '*' + kms:CallerAccount narrows to the account (contrast to 111)
note: acceptance-suite-4 test 112. kms:CallerAccount is a principal-ACCOUNT scoping key (the KMS analog of aws:PrincipalAccount): combined with Principal '*' it narrows the grant to all authenticated identities in the named account. kms:ViaService additionally pins the channel. The '*' is NARROWED (not public/critical) with principalScopedBy=[kms:CallerAccount], and the AND composition of the two keys is preserved (not collapsed to OR). The KMS-VIASERVICE-NOT-SCOPING note does NOT fire (the grant IS principal-scoped here).
